scope: Wave E — ordinary 34+ scenes requiring authoritative unattached/free-agent state
globalRules: Free agency/unattached status must be an explicit authoritative employment/registration state.
monthsRemaining <= 0 currently means expired_pending_resolution and is not sufficient.
Market silence must be measured against real professional offer/contact history over real elapsed time; low marketHeat is not silence.
A narrative scene cannot fabricate a formal offer in order to end market silence.
Lowering salary/level changes willingness/search posture; it does not directly sign a club or alter tier.
Any protagonist career-retirement choice delegates terminal transition to Agent 9.
All events additionally require Wave 0 lineage, canonical seed catalog/provenance and save/pending/history compatibility.
